1.author: kikevin3000
1.description: Demonic Power now also increases the damage of your Imp's Firebolt and your Succubus' Lash of Pain by 5/10%.

1.author: Perth(214980069209145345)
1.description: Improved Stormstrike now also has a 50/100% chance to increase the Fire and Frost damage your target takes from you by 10% for 6 seconds.

1.author: Perth(214980069209145345)
1.description: Dual Wield Specialization (Enhancement) now also increases your spell hit by 1/2/3%.

1.author: Perth(214980069209145345)
1.description: Deep Freeze is temporarily disabled while we search for a permanent solution.

1.author: Perth(214980069209145345)
1.description: Touched by the Light now only grants its critical heal bonus to Holy spells.

1.author: Perth(214980069209145345)
1.description: Bane has been reworked. It now has 3 ranks which reduce the cast time of your Shadow Bolt, Chaos Bolt, and Immolate by 0.17/0.34/0.5 seconds.

1.author: Perth(214980069209145345)
1.description: Improved Healing Wave has been reworked. It now has 3 ranks which reduce the cast time of your Healing Wave by 0.17/0.34/0.5 seconds.

1.author: Perth(214980069209145345)
1.description: Lightning Mastery has been reworked. It now has 3 ranks which reduce the cast time of your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Lava Burst by 0.17/0.34/0.5 seconds.

1.author: Perth(214980069209145345)
1.description: Divine Fury has been reworked. It now has 3 ranks which reduce the cast time of your Smite, Holy Fire, Heal, and Greater Heal by 0.17/0.34/0.5 seconds.

1.author: Perth(214980069209145345)
1.description: Improved Frostbolt has been reworked. It now has 3 ranks which reduce the cast time of your Frostbolt by 0.17/0.34/0.5 seconds.

1.author: Perth(214980069209145345)
1.description: Improved Fireball has been reworked. It now has 3 ranks which reduce the cast time of your Fireball by 0.17/0.34/0.5 seconds.

1.author: Perth(214980069209145345)
1.description: Naturalist has been reworked. It now has 3 ranks which reduce the cast time of your Healing Touch by 0.17/0.34/0.5 and increases your Physical damage by 1/2/3%.

1.author: Perth(214980069209145345)
1.description: Starlight Wrath has been reworked. It now has 3 ranks which reduce the cast time of your Wrath and Starfire ability by 0.17/0.34/0.5 seconds.

1.author: Perth(214980069209145345)
1.description: Arcane Stability has been reworked. It now has 3 ranks which reduce the pushback suffered from damaging attacks while casting Arcane Missiles and Arcane Blast by 33/66/100% and reduces the mana cost of your Arcane Missiles by 2/4/6%.

1.author: Perth(214980069209145345)
1.description: Spiritual Focus has been reworked. It now has 3 ranks which reduce the pushback suffered from damaging attacks while casting Flash of Light and Holy Light by 33/66/100%. More to come in the future.

1.author: Perth(214980069209145345)
1.description: Stormstrike debuff no longer has charges, lasts 6 seconds, down from 12, and now properly increases the damage of all Nature damage dealt by the player.

1.author: Perth(214980069209145345)
1.description: Deflection (Arms) has been reworked. It now has 3 ranks and increases your Parry by 1/2/3% and gives you a 33/66/100% when you Parry an attack to allow the use Victory Rush for 10 seconds. This effect has a 10 second internal cooldown.

1.author: Perth(214980069209145345)
1.description: Martyrdom reworked. Now grants a 6 second Silence immunity and is now on a 20 seconds internal cooldown.

1.author: Perth(214980069209145345)
1.description: Icy Veins now grants immunity to Silence and Interrupt effects for 10 seconds. If Icy Veins gets dispelled, so does the immunity buff.

1.author: Perth(214980069209145345)
1.description: Ignite now reduces the healing the target receives by 10/20/30/40/50%.

1.author: Perth(214980069209145345)
1.description: Improved Kidney Shot now also has a 33/66/100% chance to silence the target for 2 seconds.

1.author: Perth(214980069209145345)
1.description: Ice Block no longer triggers the global cooldown.

1.author: Perth(214980069209145345)
1.description: Omen of Clarity has had its tooltip updated to reflect its internal cooldown.

1.author: Perth(214980069209145345)
1.description: Second Wind has had its tooltip updated to reflect its internal cooldown.

1.author: Perth(214980069209145345)
1.description: Vengeance now stacks up to 5 times, from 3, but now lasts 15 seconds, down from 30.

1.author: Perth(214980069209145345)
1.description: Holy Power has been reworked. It now has 3 ranks which increase your Holy damage by 2/4/6%. (This is a temporary rework and we plan to change this talent again in the future.)

1.author: Perth(214980069209145345)
1.description: Demon Skin and Armor no longer trigger the global cooldown, but have 1 second internal cooldown.

1.author: Perth(214980069209145345)
1.description: Frost and Ice Armor no longer trigger the global cooldown, but have a 1 second internal cooldown.

1.author: Perth(214980069209145345)

1.author: Perth(214980069209145345)
1.description: Righteous Vengeance now also procs from Hammer of the Righteous, and its damage has been increased to 15/30/45%, up from 10/20/30%.

1.author: Perth(214980069209145345)
1.description: Unleashed Rage now grants 2/4/6 expertise, up from 1/2/3, and also grants 4/7/10% increased non-physical damage done while under the effects of Shamanistic Rage.

1.author: Perth(214980069209145345)
1.description: Savage Fury now grants 10/20% bonus damage to Claw, Rake, Mangle (Bear), Mangle (Cat), and Maul, down from 15/30%, and it now also increases the damage of Shred by 3/6%.

1.author: Perth(214980069209145345)
1.description: Rake now costs 35 energy, down from 40, and its initial damage now scales with 5% of your attack power, up from 1%.

1.author: Perth(214980069209145345)
1.description: Savage Combat has had its tooltip corrected to reflect it only increases melee attack power.

1.author: Perth(214980069209145345)
1.description: Ferocious Bite has had its energy cost reduced to 30, down from 35.

1.author: Perth(214980069209145345)
1.description: Improved Moonkin Form now also increases the armor granted by cloth and leather items while in Moonkin Form by 30/60/90%.

1.author: Perth(214980069209145345)
1.description: Moonkin Form now increases your armor contribution from cloth and leather items by 280%, down from 370%, and it now reduces your threat by 15%.
